name: Button
description: Tactile 3D glass action trigger with dynamic specular refraction, glow response, and multi-state depth physics.

name: Text Input
description: Concave translucent glass entry field featuring inner ambient occlusion, glowing focus borders, floating label, and clear action.

name: Textarea
description: Multi-line frosted glass surface with etched grid accents, live character counter, resizable grip, and fluid focus states.

name: Checkbox
description: Beveled glass toggle box featuring volumetric depth, animated checkmark drawing, and luminous emerald-cyan active glow.

name: Radio Button
description: Convex liquid droplet selector with floating glass ring, animated core sphere expansion, and mutually exclusive group physics.

name: Switch / Toggle
description: Pill-shaped frosted channel housing a floating illuminated glass bead that glides smoothly across friction-free rails.

name: Select / Dropdown
description: Sculpted crystal dropdown trigger paired with an elevated floating frosted listbox with smooth optic dispersion.

name: Combobox / Autocomplete
description: Hybrid searchable glass input with live filtered suggestion drop-sheet, item highlighting, and quick keyboard completion.

name: Slider
description: 3D refractive glass cylinder track with glowing fill progress and an elevated prismatic gem thumb with tooltip value.

name: Date / Time Picker
description: Multi-tier glass calendar slab displaying month grid, animated selection ripples, quick-jump month tabs, and precise time dials.

name: Card
description: Volumetric liquid glass panel with layered parallax surfaces, dynamic specular highlights that follow mouse movement, and rich content hierarchy.

name: Modal / Dialog
description: Heroic floating 3D glass fortress elevated above a dimmed, blurred backdrop with chromatic perimeter refraction and smooth spring entry.

name: Drawer / Sheet
description: Slide-in frosted side monolith with edge highlights, gesture dismissal handle, and seamless glass blur integration.

name: Accordion
description: Stack of interlocking crystal slats that expand with fluid ease, revealing nested glass content cards with chevron flip motion.

name: Navbar / App Bar
description: Floating translucent command bar with bevel-lit glass trim, integrated brand jewel, nav links with sliding glow indicator, and CTA.

name: Sidebar / Navigation Rail
description: Vertical glass monolith with collapsible icon rail, sub-menu popouts, user profile capsule, and illuminated active item indicators.

name: Tabs
description: Segmented 3D glass tray with a floating luminous indicator pill that slides seamlessly beneath the active tab label.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Linear glass trail with micro-faceted separators, subtle path hover glows, and current page crystal badge.

name: Pagination
description: Row of bevel-edged glass numeric buttons with active illuminated plate, smooth prev/next steppers, and page jump dial.

name: Badge
description: Microscopic glowing glass jewel with pulsed status halo, iridescent core, and crisp micro-typography.

name: Chip / Tag
description: Compact interactive glass capsule with removable 3D crystal cross, avatar thumbnail, and selectable state toggle.

name: Tooltip
description: Ultra-light floating frosted bubble with directional prism beak, micro drop shadow, and instant directional orientation.

name: Popover
description: Interactive multi-element glass pod anchoring to trigger elements, complete with header, rich interactive form/card body, and close action.

name: Icon Pack
description: Cohesive family of 12 handcrafted 3D liquid glass icons sharing identical specular highlights, depth layers, cyan-sapphire refraction, and vector geometries.

name: Alert / Callout
description: Prominent glass warning bar with chromatic edge illumination, status insignia, rich body text, and optional action buttons.

name: Toast / Notification
description: Floating corner glass notification shard that slides onto the viewport with time-decay progress bar and instant action.

name: Progress Bar
description: 3D frosted tube with liquid-light energy core, iridescent wave shimmer animation, and percentage badge.

name: Spinner / Loading Indicator
description: Hypnotic rotating 3D glass torus with trailing luminous particles, refractive caustic ring, and variable speed control.

name: Avatar / Avatar Group
description: Layered disc stack of frosted glass lens portraits with depth-staggered hover elevation, online presence jewels, and overflow counter.

name: Skeleton Loader
description: Translucent glass bone structures with shimmering light reflections that sweep across card and text placeholders.
functional_requirements: multiple layout shapes (avatar, title, paragraph, button)

name: Table / Data Grid
description: Multi-column frosted glass data console with sticky headers, sortable column chevrons, row selection highlights, and glass cell dividers.

name: Tree View
description: Hierarchical glass file system explorer with expanding crystal branches, custom 3D folder icons, and active node highlight plates.

name: Stepper / Wizard
description: Progressive sequence of crystal step nodes connected by glowing liquid energy conduits, tracking workflow progression.

name: Segmented Control
description: Precision-milled recessed glass tray housing an elevated optical glass selector block that glides between view options.

name: Rating / Star Picker
description: Row of faceted crystal stars that illuminate with amber liquid fire on hover and lock into place with a subtle 3D pop.

name: File Upload / Dropzone
description: Spacious frosted glass receiving bay with etched dashed perimeter, drag-over optical lens expansion, file queue chips, and upload progress.
functional_requirements: file validation chip list with size & remove action

name: Color Picker
description: Luminescent glass palette console with chromatic spectrum gradient slab, 3D reticle selector, opacity slider, and hex readout.
functional_requirements: hue and alpha glass slider rails

name: Audio Player
description: Futuristic glass deck with floating disc play button, dynamic glowing frequency visualizer bars, track scrubber, and volume prism.

name: Video Player
description: Immersive glass theater frame with floating auto-hide control bar, 3D time scrub dial, picture-in-picture glass trigger, and volume slider.

name: Carousel / Slider Showcase
description: 3D coverflow-style carousel where frosted glass cards rotate in true 3D perspective with depth fading and optical navigation dots.

name: Timeline
description: Vertical glass spine punctuated with glowing crystal milestones and staggered glass cards detailing historical logs.

name: Statistic / Metric Card
description: Executive glass dashboard tile featuring illuminated KPI figures, mini sparkline trend curve, and positive/negative trend pills.
functional_requirements: percentage delta indicator with up/down arrow

name: Pricing Table
description: Trio of stepped glass monoliths featuring popular plan jewel accent, billing interval toggle, feature checklist, and liquid CTA button.
functional_requirements: checklist feature rows with check icons

name: Command Palette / Spotlight
description: Floating glass command center with hotkey trigger, fuzzy search input, grouped action listings, and keyboard navigation shortcuts.
functional_requirements: arrow key navigation with active glass glow

name: Bottom Navigation Bar
description: Curved mobile glass floating dock anchored to screen bottom with thumb-friendly tap targets and rising liquid indicator bubble.

name: Floating Action Button (FAB)
description: Spherical optical crystal sphere suspended in space that expands into a fan of secondary glass quick-action nodes upon interaction.

name: Split Button / Action Menu
description: Unified glass capsule divided by a micro-refractive seam separating primary click execution from a secondary dropdown caret.

name: Divider / Glass Separator
description: Etched prismatic glass hairline rule with centered floating icon medallion and fading luminescence at the margins.
functional_requirements: centered optional badge or icon label

name: Empty State
description: Minimalist glass showcase containing a floating 3D refractive ghost gem illustration, explanatory headline, and primary recovery button.
functional_requirements: clear headline and helpful body copy

name: KPI Gauge / Circular Meter
description: Radial 3D glass speedometer with glowing neon liquid fill arc, central crystal readout value, and needle/target markers.

name: Floating Dock
description: macOS-inspired liquid glass shelf featuring parabolic icon magnification on proximity, active reflection mirror, and bouncy app indicators.
functional_requirements: frosted glass shelf with mirrored reflection
